title: Randers fire past Naestved to claim Cup title
description: Randers - Naestved 101-98 (OT) Randers are 2026 Cup winners. They held off Naestved in the Final tonight. Adama Darboe (190-G-1986) came up with impressive 39 points, while X Rice added 24 points for the winners. Randers jumped off to a 32-18 lead after ten minutes. Naestved however narrowed the deficit in the second and third terms. They got within two points heading into the fourth frame 67-69. Naestved erased the deficit in the fourth quarter and finally Victor Searls (206-F, college: Ohio) gave his team an 83-81 lead with 42 seconds remaining. But Adama Darboe converted a layup to force overtime. Randers however sank 18 points in the extra period to ice the win.
imageCaption: Randers fire past Naestved to claim Cup title (Photo: Randers FB)

title: Bakken Bears celebrate BasketLigaen title
description: Bakken - Svendborg 82-63 Bakken Bears stormed past Svendborg to claim Ligaen title. Bakken dominated down low during the game scoring 54 of its points in the paint compared to Svendborg's 28. Bakken forced 20 Svendborg turnovers and outrebounded them 47-36 including 18 on the offensive glass. Bakken looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. The game was dominated by American players. Center Jacob Polakovich (208-2000, college: S.Indiana) fired a double-double by scoring 18 points and 13 rebounds for the winners. Forward Urald King (198-1990, college: SE Oklahoma) chipped in a double-double by scoring 10 points and 17 rebounds. Four Bakken players scored in double figures. Forward Isiah Small (202-1998, college: Texas St.) produced 17 points and 9 rebounds and guard Jemarl Baker Jr (195-1998, college: N.Mexico) added 14 points and 12 rebounds respectively for lost side.…
imageCaption: Bakken Bears celebrate BasketLigaen title (Photo: facebook)

title: Bakken sweep Naestved to repeat as Ligaen champions
description: Naestved - Bakken 86-88 Bakken Bears extended their Ligaen dominance. They swept Naestved to conquer the 8th straight title. The guests trailed by 9 points after three quarters before their 25-14 charge, which allowed them to win the game. Bakken made 16-of-20 free shots (80.0 percent) during the game. American guard Malik Parsons (190-1999, college: NWOSU) fired 21 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. The other American import forward DeAndre Pinckney (203-2000, college: Southern Miss) chipped in 22 points and 6 rebounds. Dutch forward Lagio Grantsaan (203-1997, college: Morgan St.) produced a double-double by scoring 15 points and 10 rebounds and American forward Gus Okafor (201-1999, college: Wichita St.) added 21 points respectively for lost side. Four Bakken and five Naestved players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Bakken sweep Naestved to repeat as Ligaen champions (Photo: BasketLigaen)

title: BasketLigaen Round 4 of Finals. Bakken Bears defend the title
description: Naestved - Bakken 66-87 Bakken Bears celebrated the 21st Ligaen title in team's history. They overcame Naestved to complete the sweep of the championship series and earned the seventh straight Ligaen trophy. The guests were tied at the half but managed to speed up in last two quarters eventually winning the game. Bakken dominated on the defensive end, holding Naestved to just 6 points in third quarter. They dominated down low during the game scoring 48 of its points in the paint compared to Naestved's 28 and made 18-of-22 free shots (81.8 percent) during the game. International forward Darko Jukic (199-1990) fired 15 points, 7 rebounds and 7 assists for the winners. American forward Ryan Evans (202-1990, college: Wisconsin) chipped in 16 points, 8 rebounds and 5 assists and was named the Finals MVP. Four Bakken players scored in double figures. title: Bakken Bears clinch Ligaen title
description: Svendborg - Bakken 77-81 Bakken Bears celebrated Ligaen title. They edged Svendborg on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. The Bears therefore claimed the sixth straight Ligaen trophy. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 24-17. But Svendborg won second period 17-12. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Worth to mention a great performance of American center Travis Taylor (203-1990, college: Xavier, agency: Slash Sports) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 19 points and 11 rebounds. The other American import point guard Marvelle Harris (196-1993, college: Fresno St., agency: Slash Sports) contributed with 22 points for the winners. title: Bakken Bears earn BasketLigaen title
description: Horsens IC - Bakken 87-96 Bakken Bears claimed BasketLigaen title. They snapped two-game losing skid in the championship series and upset Horsens IC on the road to capture the title. The guests trailed by 1 point at the halftime before their 59-49 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. American forward Ryan Evans (202-90, college: Wisconsin) had a double-double by scoring 14 points, 14 rebounds and 4 assists to lead the charge for the winners and Senegalese center Michel Diouf (208-89) chipped in 17 points and 8 rebounds during the contest. The best for the losing side was Bosnian forward Vedran Borovcanin (199-85) with 30 points and American guard Gage Davis (193-95, college: St.Cloud St.) produced a double-double by scoring 16 points and 13 rebounds. Five Bakken and four Horsens IC players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Bakken Bears earn BasketLigaen title (Photo: jyllands-posten.dk)
